batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: run out (R Shukla, Q de Kock)

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c S Rana b AN Ahmed

batting.name: KP Pietersen
batting.dismissal: st PA Patel b YS Chahal

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c YS Chahal b M Muralitharan

balls.text: some relief for Shukla as he bowls a slower ball outside off and Yuvraj swings and for a change doesn't connect
his ninth six! He bowls length and he gets forward and he pulls and it just clears the rope at long leg
what does Shukla do? He lets go of a high full toss that;s too high and it even beats de Kock, Rana charges off and is sent back
another hat-trick of sixes! Will he give us a break? No he won't! This was dragged short, Shukla trying to vary his length but the result is the same, pulled and it just clears deep midwicket
another half volley is punished! Outside off and he gets under the bounce and lofts downtown, several rows over wide long-off
50 for Yuvi! This was a half volley outside off and he gets underneath the bounce and scoops it high over extra cover
Yuvraj takes an off stump guard and moves further to his left as Shukla delivers, but he sprays it too wide outside off
down the leg side and swings and the keeper gets a glove to it, rolls to fine leg
keeps him quiet with a yorker outside off
just over deep midwicket! This was a low full toss and he swings this away and it's high and just evades a brave attempt by Karthik at the edge of the rope
that was a yorker wide outside off and close to being called wide, Yuvraj was standing wide outside leg
low full toss wide outside off and mistimed to cover
tries to slap it straight but ends up swatting it to point, Yuvraj was through quickly but Rana had to hurry
full outside the off stump and drilled firmly down to long-off
hooks the short ball but not fully in control, the top edge just clears short fine leg, Kaul charges after it and puts in the dive but the ball wins
drills it down to long-on
a few rows over the second tier! Nobody can nod off, Shami bowls down the leg side and it's a pick up shot played with such ease over fine leg
full on the off stump and he mistimes the drive to the off side
he risks dropping it short and Yuvraj pulls and finds deep midwicket
bowls it too wide outside off and he doesn't play at it
slogged along the ground towards deep square leg, the fielder dives and parries the ball to another
drills it hard down to long-off
a hat-trick of sixes! This was the googly tossed up outside off and he lofts him down town, nearly into the second tier over the sight screen
two in two! Tahir tosses it up too wide outside off and Yuvraj scoops it high and over deep cover
heads up! That was a Yuvi special, Tahir bowls length and flat and Yuvraj read the length early, on his knee and slogged several rows over deep square leg
fires that flat and quick and Yuvraj is solid in defense
stifled appeal as the bowler thought it was pad first and the bat
very good fielding by Jadhav at deep midwicket, Rana clips a low full toss to the deep, Jadhav dives and pushes it away, gathers himself and prevents it from rolling back to the rope
clips a low full toss down to deep midwicket
swings across the line and gets an inside edge to the leg side
Yuvraj misses out on the Free Hit, good slower ball wide outside off and he swings and misses, bat nowhere near the ball
he oversteps and fires it down the leg side
makes room and he fires it full outside leg and he drills it to long-off
just picks the gap at backward point and the sweeper mops up
gives him width and he looks to cut but misses
drops it on the pitch and he decides against the single
full outside off and driven to cover
knocks back the off stump, after being spanked for a boundary the previous ball AB tries to hoick him across the line, comes back in off the pitch and shaves the off stump, the stumps are erect
suspect fielding again! This was full and wide and hammered by AB off the front foot, extra cover doesn't time his dive right and it races away
stays back and punches the googly down to deep cover for a couple
It's a direct hit and it goes upstairs, turned to deep midwicket and he goes for the second run, it's a flat throw at the stumps and Yuvraj is home
goes for the big drive but can't beat cover
rolls to the on side
bit streaky, tossed up and he didn't quite read the googly, gets an outside edge that just about clears backward point and rolls to third man
full outside off and driven to cover
doesn't give him room and he punches it back to the bowler
good yorker outside off and he looks to dig it out but misses
flicks a low full toss on the pads to deep square leg

soft dismissal, this was the slower ball and bowled short, Parthiv didn't really pick it, hopped at the crease and looked to slice it over backward point, neither here nor there, half heartedly slices it to Karthik who leaps in that position
good yorker outside off and drilled away
lofts him down the ground and falls safely in front of long-on

the fielding's coming apart in this over! This was a full one outside and AB bashes this on the front foot flat towards long-off, Shukla was in a awkward position, unsure whether to go for the catch or stay back and save the four, bounces one and sails past him to the boundary
picks the slower ball early, this was dragged a bit too short and AB picked this from the off stump and clubs it flat over deep midwicket
Vijay makes a mess of it in the deep! This was a low full toss outside off and he drives it firmly towards deep cover and Vijay over runs it and cannot get a hand to it, didn't time the dive well
drops it down towards point and sets off
swings him across the line and Shukla slips at long-on after gathering the ball and manages to stay in control of the throw
he mistimes the punch to the off side
punishes Tahir's length, this was dropped short, went back quickly and pulled and found the gap at deep square leg, beats the sweeper
drills this one down the ground and still work for Kaul
he really biffed that down the ground, Parthiv went forward to a half volley and really tested Kaul at long-off who dived in vain
it's a low full toss which he forces down to long-on
gets turn but it's too wide outside off and he bashes it towards wide long-off
full and wide and drilled towards long-off
power behind that, dropped short outside off and he rocked back and slapped it wide of point and the sweeper couldn't cut it off
down the pitch and the ball rolls off his pads
looked to slap that square of the wicket and he gets an outside edge to third man
he fires it on the pads, down the track and worked to the on side
flatter one and he works it away towards square leg
he comes round the wicket and works it away down to midwicket
stays back and punches it wide of cover
spins the googly from outside leg and strikes the pad , loud appeal but you have to see where it pitched
plays the late cut down to third man
running a bit haywire here, nudged to the on side and Parthiv takes a circuitous route to the other end, tries to get out of the way of the bowler

there's an appeal for a run out and it's close! Kohli's in trouble. Kohli was down the track and got an inside edge that trickled past the stumps, he's very keen on the second run but Rahul Shukla's arm gets the better off him, fires the throw flat and fast from fine leg to the keeper de Kock who breaks the bails, the bat is just short
slower ball and pushed softly down to point and sets off
this was full outside off and he drives him down to deep cover
full on middle and off and he works it away down to deep midwicket
full and nudged off the pads to the leg side
that's a good slower ball, landed on a yorker length and Parthiv played all around it
stays beside the line and dabs it down to third man
swept firmly but straight to Pietersen at short fine leg
down the track and he gets a leading edge to the off side
gets on his knee and sweeps square
going for the big drive and he gets an outside edge that goes one bounce to short third man
tossed up and he drives this down to long-on
a little short of a length and he calmly guides it down to third man
he stays back and punches it to the off side
this was a touch wide outside off and he's happy to leave it alone

leg stump's outta here! Shukla comes round the wicket to Gayle, he comes down the track looking to swing across the line but gets a thick inside edge that sends the leg stump for a short spin, lands a few yards back
comes round the wicket and he turns it to square leg
gets away with a half volley, outside off and driven hard to cover

that was quite stylish by Parthiv! A low full toss and Parthiv looked to play this to the on side and used his wrists really well to pick the gap at deep midwicket bisecting two men, fetched that from outside off too
pushes it to the off side but mistimes it
high full toss but within the permissible limit, the yorker didn't come out, he punches it to the on side
this was fired full outside off and wider on seeing Gayle make room, Gayle opted out of the shot
straight again and he stays back and punches it to the off side
good start by Kaul, cramped him up and he punched it to the off side
cracked that past cover, this was a half volley outside off waiting to be spanked, driven along the ground
swing and a miss, looked like Shami took some pace off the ball
fullish on the pads and he works it away towards midwicket
that's a very good yorker from Shami to the big man, he manages to dig it out
flicks it softly towards midwicket for a single
Parthiv looks to drop it on the pitch and pinch a single but he is hesitant
rocks back and punches it wide of cover and Vijay gives chase
missed out there, over the wicket this time and bowled outside leg, looked to slog and is struck on the pad
not fully in control but good enough, he was down the pitch and played across the line, inside edge but it beats midwicket and the long-on fielder
into the second tier! Tossed up on middle and Gayle was a few paces down the track and lofted this over the sight screen
flatter one and he pushes it back to the bowler
down the pitch and he drives down the ground and long-off picks up
crowd comes alive! This was fired on a length and Gayle was down the track and he whipped that flat over deep midwicket
a bit too straight and he nudges it down to short fine leg, Parthiv misses out on a boundary
Gayle comes down the track and he looks to pull but the ball hits his body and rolls away
this was on a good length and he punches it down the track
one of those strange Gayle shots, this one kicked up off a length and Gayle was nearly sliced in half, wanted to punch it straight but withdrew
Shami keeps it tight, no room for Gayle as he stabs it to the off side
tossed up and fuller and he pushes it towards cover
gives it more air to Parthiv and he gets turn too, outside edge to the off side
full on the pads and clipped towards midwicket
this was quicker and Gayle is happy to come forward and defend
bowls it flatter and he stays back and punches down the track
one slip in place, Gayle stays back and defends
fires that on the stumps and he spoons it towards mid-off and RCB celebrate a 16-run win in front of their home fans well past midnight
punches it down to mid-off and Kohli takes aim at the bowler's end and misses
appeal for a run out and Jadhav's in trouble. Shukla swings and misses, they try to steal a bye, Parthiv aims at the stumps and Jadhav's just short
Shukla makes room and goes for the big swing and misses
this was fuller and he can only drill it down to deep cover
will that set the tone for the rest of the over? This was a slower ball but a half volley, he got under it and sent it miles over wide long-off
full on middle and leg and he drills it down to long-on
Shukla makes room and he swings it down to deep square leg
Free Hit: It's a slower ball which he slogs to deep midwickewt and only a single
it's a front foot no-ball, bonus for DD, clips it to deep midwicket
follows it up with a swing and  a miss

that was very cleverly played! He knew third man was up, he moved right across his stumps, cleared the right leg and was looking to hoick it over the leg side, adjusted late and deftly guided it to third man instead, turned the bat perfectly
they're going to throw their bats at everything, this was short and Jadhav pulled and the outside edge comfortably cleared the keeper
a bit too quick for him, he made room to swing but missed
length ball and he makes room to swing but misses
the middle stump's knocked back! It was a length ball bowled straight at the stumps, came back in slightly, Duminy swung across the line at thin air and his stump was pushed back
nearly carried all the way! He used the pace on the ball, made room and sliced it over backward point and the ball was going quickly, dipped just before reaching the rope
bowls length outside off and he drives it down to AB at long-off
he works it down to deep midwicket

Dropped by Gayle at point! Duminy looked to slice this over the off side and the big man leaps and gets a hand to it, tries to take it in the second attempt with the other and it still pops out, tries for the third time, he nearly does the split as he falls to the ground
penalised for a waist high full toss, was a bit hard on the bowler, this was worked to deep square leg and Chahal nearly over-ran it near the rope
turning out to be an expensive over already, this was a length ball outside off which he pulls along the ground and beats midwicket
that was flat! Ahmed bowls it too wide and it was a half volley, free swing and it went really quickly and cleared deep extra cover
JP tries to paddle that to fine leg from outside off, the ball hits his pads
good comeback, fires that full outside off and he tries to dig it out
that's not a bad start to the over at all, this was a full ball and he got under the bounce and lofted it, falls inches short of the straight boundary
drops it fractionally short and mistimes the pull
comes down the track and punches it to sweeper cover
he goes back and punches it to the off side
pushed through quicker and it was an inside edge that sneaks past the stumps, brushes Parthiv's pad and rolls to short fine leg
works it down to deep midwicket
takes a few paces down and pushes it back to the bowler
Chahal gives DD an opening by bowling a half tracker, Duminy was almost expecting it, back at the crease and bludgeoned high over deep midwicket
stays back to punch the googly and it's in the air and it drops short of cover
bit too close to cut and he ends up chopping it to short third man
fetches that from outside off and slogs him down to deep midwicket
works it against the turn to fine leg
big turn again, Jadhav can only push it back to the bowler
driven back to the bowler
misfield by Chahal at backward point, Duminy stays back at the crease and waits for it, it was pushed quicker and he used the pace to cut firmly
down the track and he works it down to deep midwicket
fires that full outside off and driven down to deep cover
full outside off and driven down to long-off
on the pads and he tucks it away to deep midwicket
the run rate pressure getting to Karthik, it was in the slot for Karthik to pull as it was dropped a bit short, swiveled and pulled flat to Chahal at deep midwicket
he rocks back and punches it down to deep point
good running, he turned it down to midwicket and takes the first one hard
gets forward and drives him down to mid-off
stays back and works it down to midwicket
almost bowled him! Tossed up by Murali from round the wicket, he went down to sweep and he missed it
foxed him for turn! And that was some sharp legspin, he saw KP advance down the track, bowled it flatter and shorter, the spin did the rest and an easy stumping for Parthiv, KP throws his head back
he drops it too short and gets punished, Duminy was waiting for it, he stays back and pulls high over deep midwicket
rocks back and thumps it really hard and the fielder at deep cover had to hurry and he did well
he rocks back and punches it hard to deep point
there's the biggie from Duminy, this was the googly tossed up, Duminy went down on his knee, picked it and slogged it several rows over long-on
he looks to play the reverse sweep and it doesn't come off, hits the pads and rolls away, Maxwell's shaking his head somewhere
goes back and punches against the turn to the on side
he comes down the track, checks his shot and plays it to long-on
goes back at the crease and punches it down the track
makes room and cuts him against the turn and Chahal does well to slide at deep point
comes round the wicket, sharp spin and he makes room and punches it to long-off
fires that full and wide outside off and he drives to sweeper cover
gets off the mark with a quick single down to midwicket, beats the throw
he goes back at the crease and pushes it to the off side
punched firmly down to long-on
this was a length ball on the stumps and Agarwal was looking to send it over long-on but he didn't go through with the shot fully, went flat to Rana
gets it high on the bat and cuts him down to point
looked to cut and missed, looked very ungainly
makes room and punches it to sweeper cover
bashed hard to Star who times the dive very well at deep midwicket and fires the throw to keep it to just a single
Yuvraj tossed it up a bit more and a bit slower, KP clears the left leg and lofts with ease over the covers, easily done
comes down the track and mistimes it to the leg side
punches it down to extra cover
mistimed it to the off side
that's a lovely straight hit by Agarwal, tossed up by Chahal and he was down the track and lofted it dead straight over the sightscreen
gets forward and drives him to midwicket
streaky there as KP gets a leading edge that just clears cover who leaps
fetches that from outside off and sweeps, it's in the air and picked up at fine leg
beats the drive! The turn foxing him, very close to the off stump
dabs it late down to short third man
it's a low full toss which he drills down to AB at long-off
KP wins the opening round v Yuvi - he drops it too short and KP rocks back and pulls over deep midwicket
he gets an inside edge to the boot
goes for the drive and gets an outside edge to short third man
gets forward and drives towards point
gets forward and drives to long-off
drops it too short, Agarwal waits for the turn before cutting it hard down to deep point
sharp spin again and he cuts to the off side
Dropped by Gayle at slip, sharp turn and he made room to cut and it went quickly to Gayle who grabbed and fumbled
goes back and mistimes the drive
nothing scratchy about that, dropped it short and he rocked back and punched it hard down to deep cover
another inside edge, KP looking scratchy
he opens the face and guides this to third man
gets an inside edge to the pad and the ball rolls to point
mistimed the pull, it was up in the air and dropped just wide of midwicket, Chahal and Rana went after it
knocks it towards midwicket
this was too wide outside off and KP chased it
that sliced everyone in half! It came back in and cut KP in half and just cleared the stumps and Parthiv didn't see that either, KP was all over the place after the ball passed him
mistimes the pull to deep square leg
tucks it to the on side
streaky again but safe, this was sliced squarer on the off side and cleared backward point
Dropped at cover by Kohli but it was a tough one, leans forward and spoons the drive over the off side, Kohli leaps and the ball brushes his fingers
fires that full and wide outside off and he drills it to point
he strays wide down the leg side and wide called
KP goes for the big drive through the off side but the ball goes underneath the bat
flatter delivery, dabbed straight to cover
how did that miss! It was not short enough to cut.. The batsman misses and it misses the stumps
Super hit! He takes a forward stride and just lifts it straight over Murali's head.. All the way over long on
he charges out and almost pays the price as this starts spinning down the leg side, KP is lucky to get some pad on it
tossed up on the middle stump line, the batsman nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single
waits on the back foot and defends the pushed through delivery to off

the leg stump is uprooted! RCB are red, red with energy! This one is smartly bowled from Starc, the cross-seamed delivery.. It doesn't swing and QdK, who was looking to play it on the up through off, gets a thick inside edge on to his stumps
fuller delivery outside off, the batsman drives it straight to cover
looks for the inswinging yorker but serves up a low full toss on off, the batsman pushes it to cover for a single
back of length delivery on off, the batsman drops it to the leg side and calls for a quick single
length delivery outside off, QdK comes forward and defends to  off
bowls a full and swinging delivery outside off, nicely timed to cover point and it;s Yuvraj again, at point, diving to his right and saving some runs.. What confidence!
and there is an edge now! Past the second slip fielder, runs away to the boundary
tossed up on off, the batsman defends it to point and looks for a single before turning back, an overthrow allows an extra run
there comes the wicket! Murali takes out Murali Vijay! the batsman looks to sweep across the line and misses a straighter one.. It was hitting middle stump

is that a run-out! Murali is not able to collect the ball at non-striker's! de Kock was miles out of the crease! He got an inside edge towards the short fine leg fielder and Vijay called for a run.. QdK was slow to respond and would have been heading back had Murali taken that cleanly
he pushes it to Yuvraj at mid-off and calls for a quick single.. Yuvraj comes in like a fireball, picks it up and has a shy at stumps, misses by a whisker.. Vijay was gone had he hit
tossed up on off stump, Vijay comes forward and defends
